# BuzzBaazaar

> Pakistan’s viral street and content marketing partner for global brands. We make noise in all the right places.

BuzzBaazaar is a Karachi-based below-the-line (BTL) and viral marketing company. It combines remote creative production (short-form video, street content, sponsored social experiments, surveys, creator campaigns) with on-ground execution in Karachi, Lahore and Islamabad (activations, sampling, ambassadors, field research, a branded rooftop-convertible fleet in Karachi). International brands are the primary audience; Pakistani brands are served at /pakistan/.

Facts: Headquarters Karachi, Pakistan. Phone/WhatsApp +92 343 3556817. Email hello@buzzbaazaar.com. Hours Monday to Saturday 10:00am to 7:00pm PKT. Prices are draft indicative 'from' prices in USD, confirmed on a strategy call. No client logos, case-study results or rankings are claimed.

## Solutions
- [Viral Content Engine](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/viral-content-engine/): Short-form street content, produced in Pakistan and delivered ready to post.
- [Creator and Influencer Campaigns](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/creator-campaigns/): The right Pakistani creators for your brief, managed end to end.
- [Sponsored Social Experiments and Shows](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/social-experiments/): Content people choose to watch, with your brand built in.
- [Surveys and Social Awareness Campaigns](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/surveys-awareness/): Run a survey your brand can own, publish and cite.
- [Elite Brand Ambassadors, Models and Actors](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/talent/): Polished on-camera and on-stage talent for premium moments.
- [Pakistan Market Entry and Testing](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/pakistan-market-entry/): Find out how Pakistan responds before you commit a full budget.
- [Field and BTL Activations](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/): Brand moments in public places, run end to end.
- [Rooftop Car Fleet](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/rooftop-car-fleet/): A branded convertible that stops the street, filmed from the first reveal.
- [Brand Ambassadors and Event Staff](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/brand-ambassadors/): Briefed, presentable teams for activations, expos and roadshows.
- [Proximity and Guerrilla Marketing](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/proximity-marketing/): Reach the customers already near you before your next sale.
- [Research and Insights](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/research-insights/): Real-world data from the streets and shelves of Pakistan.
- [Dedicated Offshore Pod](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/dedicated-pod/): A small team assigned to your brand, working as part of yours.

## Formats and methods
- [Live Quiz Activation](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/live-quiz-activation/): A game people stop for, with your brand as the question.
- [Misting Fan Zone](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/misting-fan-zone/): Give people relief from the heat, and your brand the time to be noticed.
- [Chilled Water Station](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/chilled-water-station/): Free cold water, handed out under your name.
- [Shade Tent Relief Station](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/shade-tent-relief-station/): A place to sit out of the sun, with your brand overhead.
- [ORS and Electrolyte Giveaway](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/electrolyte-giveaway/): You supply the product. We put it in the right hands, safely.
- [Heatwave Campaigns](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/heatwave-campaigns/): A whole summer plan, not a single stall.
- [Street Product Sampling](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/street-product-sampling/): Put the product in people’s hands where they already walk.
- [Door-to-Door Sampling](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/door-to-door-sampling/): Reach households directly, with proof for every route.
- [In-Store Sampling and Demo](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/in-store-sampling/): Talk to shoppers at the shelf, when they are ready to choose.
- [Copen Sampling Drive](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/copen-sampling-drive/): Samples delivered from a branded convertible, filmed as it goes.
- [Branded Cap Distribution](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/branded-cap-distribution/): A wearable ad people choose to put on.
- [Leaflet and Flyer Distribution](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/field-activations/leaflet-distribution/): Print in the right hands, with proof along the way.
- [Street Intercept Surveys](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/research-insights/street-intercept-surveys/): Ask real people a few good questions, and get answers you can use.
- [Price Comparison Survey](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/research-insights/price-comparison-survey/): Find the price shoppers accept, before you print it.
- [Brand Perception Survey](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/research-insights/brand-perception-survey/): Learn what people really think when they hear your name.
- [Blind Product Taste Test](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/research-insights/blind-taste-test/): Take the label away and see which one people prefer.
- [Pack and Label Preference Test](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/research-insights/pack-label-preference-test/): Choose the pack your shoppers actually pick.
- [Retail Shelf Audit](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/research-insights/retail-shelf-audit/): See what your product looks like on the shelf, store by store.
- [Competitor Price Tracking](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/research-insights/competitor-price-tracking/): Know what your competitors charge, week after week.
- [Mystery Shopping](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/research-insights/mystery-shopping/): See your outlets the way a customer does.
- [Street Interviews](https://www.buzzbaazaar.com/solutions/viral-content-engine/street-interviews/): Real people, one good question, and your brand in the frame.
